RTX Remix SDK headers (BGE-Remix)
=================================

remix/remix_c.h, unchanged, from NVIDIA's dxvk-remix
repository at tag remix-1.6.1 (https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/dxvk-remix).
Remix API version 0.6.5. License: MIT (LICENSE-MIT).

They must match the runtime pinned in
release/scripts/modules/bge_remix/pin.py: a runtime with a different API
minor version refuses to start (REMIXAPI_ERROR_CODE_INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION).
Update both together.
